text:
Ava (Product): Quick sync — post-launch week 1 retrospective: we need to lock down a plan for bugs vs experiments. Major customer regression from Friday still happening for some tenants. Proposed: 70% bug fixes, 30% enhancements/experiments for the next 1-week sprint. Thoughts?
Rohit (Eng): +1 to stabilization. What's the list of regressions? link?
Ava (Product): https://redwood.internal/notes/postlaunch-week1 — top three: streaming disconnects, token billing mismatch, slow cold-starts. Streaming is highest severity for 2 customers.
Sam (Eng): Streaming issue looks like race on KV cache invalidation. I can patch but need a quick infra deploy window. estimate 2d.
Marcos (Design): Any UX quick wins we can do instead of full sync? Small copy fix reduces support volume. I can ship today.
Jenna (CS): Support is flooded on the streaming one. If we can ship a roll-back toggled canary that'd help. Customers asking for ETA.
Rohit (Eng): Prefer a canary -> feature flag -> rollback. Release team: can we allocate a 1-hour canary slot tomorrow morning?
release-bot: scheduled canary deploy for staging -> canary at 1717780800; notify @release-team when ready :rocket:
Ava (Product): OK decision: 70/30 split. Owners: Streaming fix -> Rohit, Token billing -> Sam, UX copy -> Marcos. Canary tomorrow, metrics check at +24h, roll to 20% if green.
Sam (Eng): I need DB migration for billing fix; estimate 1d dev + 1d migration window. Will add migration plan to PR #5123.
Rohit (Eng): I'll draft a small rollback playbook and the feature flag.
Ava (Product): Acceptance criteria for this stabilization sprint: streaming errors <0.1% traffic, token billing discrepancy resolved on sample customers, no P0 regressions for 72h after roll.
Jenna (CS): I'll message the impacted customers with tentative canary window and status updates.
Marcos (Design): I'll push the copy PR now — should be live before canary.
Ava (Product): Follow-ups: update the backlog — tag bugs with 'postlaunch-p1' and experiments with 'postlaunch-20pct'. We'll reconvene 48h after canary to re-evaluate prioritization and decide next 2-week plan. :calendar:
Sam (Eng): PRs: #5123 (billing), #5126 (streaming patch), #5127 (UX copy). Will link in the thread.
Rohit (Eng): Noted. If anything blocks deploy, ping me directly.
Ava (Product): Thanks team. We'll run with this and I’ll post the plan to the product channel after canary is scheduled.
